sent_subject: Fell View House: fast homepage fixes for direct bookings
sent:
Hi Maya —

Thanks for introducing yourself. Quick teardown:

- Static hero with many exits; no single primary CTA to start a booking.
- No review badge or booking start above the fold.
- Handoff to an external booking portal (watch attribution drop on the hop).

Do this first
- Put an availability module in the hero beside one primary CTA (“Check availability”). Keep the CTA sticky on scroll.
- State “Book direct: 10% off, flexible cancellation, free parking” in the hero.
- Add a compact review/rating badge above the fold.
- Trim header nav to essentials; push the rest to the footer.

For paid clicks
- Use single‑promise landers (e.g., Romantic weekend, Family rooms, Last‑minute) that keep the ad’s promise on the first screen with availability and one CTA, then pass UTMs through to the portal.

Measure
- Booking‑engine sessions per 100 paid visits.
- Search‑starts per 100 visits.
- Drop‑off from CTA click to portal session.

A/B next
- Hero layout: split image + form vs form‑left, image‑right.
- CTA copy: “Check availability” vs “See rooms & rates.”
- Social proof placement: badge in hero vs just below it.

Why: as we write in our Journal, homepages built for everyone lose about half of paid traffic in the first five seconds. These changes make the first screen do bookings, not browsing.
